name: Allen County, IN
findings: Allen County has 1,345 nonprofit organizations. 563 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 450 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Allen County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 31 youth organizations here list membership, compared with about 15 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do youth organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list public events
observations.text: No research and think tank organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through research and think tank groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 133 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 133 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
